title: OpenTac: An Open Ecosystem for Customizable, Scalable, and Transferable 3D Tactile Sensing
abstract: We present OpenTac, a novel sensor and a full-stack ecosystem for tactile skins that are highly customizable, scalable, and readily deployed in downstream robot control and learning applications. Our core contribution is twofold. First, we develop a scalable resistive tactile skin with a structured deformable overlay that converts tangential loading into spatially varying pressure. Differential responses across neighboring "taxels" support decoding of local shear vectors, and the common-mode response encodes normal force. Second, we provide a highly customizable sensor design tool that is able to automatically generate fabrication files for these tactile skins from 2D outlines and developable 3D surfaces, including from abstract descriptions such as text (e.g., "design a sensor for a size 9 shoe insole"). We develop an ecosystem around the OpenTac sensor, including the CAD design tool, a sensor simulator, cross-sensor transfer, and fast/adaptive data acquisition. We demonstrate the broad applicability of the OpenTac-CAD sensor design tool by designing and fabricating more than 30 sensors across a variety of robot embodiments. We characterize the three-dimensional tactile fields produced by OpenTac with a commercial, high-precision force/torque sensor. We demonstrate the broad applicability of 3D tactile sensing across contact-rich feedback control and manipulation policy learning on four real-world robot embodiments. Additionally, adaptive acquisition enables kilohertz-rate partial readouts, exceeding full-array raster scanning on the same sensor by 19.2X at 16 sampled taxels per update for a 1024-taxel skin. We provide all hardware, software, and result videos are at opentac.github.io

analysis.sourceNote: Exact version 2610.31661v1; 14 pages; full text, method/results and limitation pages inspected. All experimental numbers are author-reported, not independently reproduced.
analysis.ideaZh: OpenTac值得作为受制造约束的procedural design案例略读：OpenTac-CAD从2D轮廓或可展曲面自动生成taxel布局、可布线flex PCB与对齐的bump case，并用真实制造验证。作者报告31块板全部DRC-clean且可工作；但语言agent演示只验证设计生成，不能视为已制造，更不是通用3D生成或新VLM能力。
analysis.motivationZh: 触觉皮肤需要随机器人表面定制几何、taxel排布、读出布线与机械盖；只换外形而不处理制造限制，难以输出可用的制造文件。
analysis.methodZh: 收录限定OpenTac-CAD子贡献：将2D outline或可展STL patch展开，在taxel尺寸、pitch、边界留量和readout资源约束下布局；以contour-following routing避让已有铜线并逐条检查clearance，输出flex-PCB制造文件、对齐bump case和共享manifest。manifest统一几何位置、scan地址、pin map和制造recipe；文本入口使用现成coding agent。
methodFlow: 输入手绘/DXF轮廓或指定STL中的可展曲面；可选现成coding agent从语言需求构造轮廓和参数。
按共享边逐三角形展开曲面，报告不能无失真展开的双曲率选择；设置taxel大小、pitch、边界与尾部几何。
在目标区域内放置taxel并预留布线空间，按readout board的行列与连接器资源分配电极和引脚。
将两面布线各视作平面问题，以嵌套/互不相交的轮廓跨度检测不可避免的crossing；从短到长沿clearance-offset轮廓绕过凹陷与既有铜线，每条route通过clearance检查才接受。
输出flex-PCB fabrication files、对齐bump case及机器可读manifest；manifest固定taxel物理位置、scan地址、footprint、pin map、mechanical group和生成recipe。
analysis.experimentsZh: 作者报告31块自动编译并制造的板全部DRC-clean且功能正常，五个重点设计编译为制造文件耗时0.7–2.6s（Sec.4.1 p.7，Fig.3/4 pp.4–5）。与同pitch最大内接矩形阵列相比，YUBI/LEAP覆盖率提升18/10个百分点，另三个重点区域持平。九个文本agent sessions均生成DRC-clean布局，但Fig.6明确它们未制造。没有与通用EDA router或其他制造生成方法系统比较，也未隔离packing/routing的模块收益；数值为作者报告，未复现。
analysis.insightZh: 可借鉴处是把sensor outline、taxel排布、双面readout-aware routing、机械对齐和共享manifest连接成一个可执行的制造编译流程，制造限制进入生成步骤而非只在结果末尾打印。论文未证明各几何或routing子算法分别首创，也没有与通用EDA自动布线或现代computational fabrication方法做系统比较；语言入口使用既有Claude Opus 5，不能归为新模型或通用agent方法。
analysis.evidenceZh: OpenTac-CAD在生成时显式处理可展曲面、taxel/pitch、边界留量、连接器及布线限制。 (Sec. 3.2, p. 5; Fig. 3A–B, p. 4) Contour-following routing按短跨度优先，在每面检测crossing并沿clearance-offset轮廓避让已有铜线。 (Sec. 3.2, Contour-following routing, p. 5) 作者报告31块自动编译并制造的板均无DRC违规且功能正常；五个重点机器人表面上有形状感知覆盖率比较。 (Sec. 4.1, p. 7; Fig. 3C, p. 4; Fig. 4A, p. 5) 语言驱动设计的九个agent sessions都生成DRC-clean布局，但论文明确没有制造这组示例。 (Sec. 4.1, pp. 7–8; Fig. 6 caption, p. 7) flex PCB不可拉伸，mesh-derived layout需要可展patch；transfer只检验normal-contact形状，未验证force accuracy或sim-to-real policy。 (Sec. 5, p. 12; Sec. 4.6, pp. 10–11)
analysis.caveatZh: flex PCB不可拉伸，曲面输入限可展patch；31块板不能保证任意轮廓均可路由。语言agent的布局示例与31块实物是两组不同实验。整体以触觉生态为主，推荐medium/skim，仅借鉴制造编译、约束路由与manifest，不追加通用3D或新VLM能力标签。公开源码经PDF打印project页追溯确认，未运行。
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 直接满足Fabrication方向的生成准入：给定几何/需求自动产出制造文件，电路间距、布线、连接器和可展性进入生成过程；可借鉴constraint-aware compilation与共享manifest。整体论文仍以触觉生态为主，因此推荐medium relevance、skim，重点阅读Sec.3.2和4.1。
